nav.requisitions_hint: Book orders to publishers: drafts, sent, and what's still expected
nav.orders_hint: Customers' orders: what's arrived, telling them, collected
nav.order_hint: A customer wants a book the shop doesn't have
nav.stocktake_hint: Count every book and correct the stock
val.draft_exists: There's already a draft for this publisher ({number}). Open that one.
val.stocktake_open: Stock-take {number} is still open. Finish or cancel it first.
req.title: Requisition
req.build_help: The draft asks again for what sold since the last requisition, and for customers' special orders.
req.has_orders: Includes {count, plural, one {# special order} other {# special orders}}.
req.close_help: What's still expected is marked not coming. Special orders in it wait for the next requisition.
order.intro: For a customer who wants a book the shop doesn't have. It goes into the publisher's next requisition.
order.phone_help: The customer is told on this number (WhatsApp) when the book arrives.
order.book_help: Type to pick from the catalogue, or type the title if it isn't there.
order.publisher_help: Only needed for a title that isn't in the catalogue.
order.advance_help: Money the customer paid now. It counts in today's sales.
order.label: Special order for {name}
order.message: Dear {name}, the book you ordered from Biblion, "{title}", has arrived. Please collect it at your convenience. Order {number}.
take.intro: Count every book on the shelves. You can stop and come back: counts are saved. Titles you don't count are left as they are.
take.apply_body: Each counted title whose count differs from the stock gets a stock change. Titles not counted stay as they are.
settings.req_auto_help: Drafts are made for every publisher with something to ask for. A manager checks and sends them.
settings.req_days_help: For a publisher's first requisition: how many days of sales to ask again for.
